name: heldout_harmful
note: Never used in extraction. 24 candidates rather than the required minimum of 10, so that if the model's natural refusal rate on work-safe prompts falls short of the 70% baseline bar, a screened subset can be selected without dropping below 10 — see checks/screen_heldout.py. Any screening that happens is recorded in the artifact and reported in the eval table; it is not hidden.
